title: Parent notification text
description: A text message from a school district to parents during a reunification: where to go, what to bring, what not to do. Short, calm and exact: it states the site, the entrance and the time, tells parents not to go to the incident location, and gives a fictional exercise information line. The EXERCISE marking is part of the message. Everything is fictional and marked as an exercise product; a real helpline number never appears without the EXERCISE marking, and no real person or address is used.

subtitle.description: Line under the organization: unit, site, period

message.description: The text of the message, under 480 characters, starting with EXERCISE
examples: EXERCISE. Students from Route 9 bus 14 are safe and being reunified at Millbrook Community Church hall, 12 Elm Street entrance. Bring photo ID. Do not go to the crash site. Next update at 16:00. Info line: 555-0120.
Spanish and Vietnamese versions sent at 15:27.
